result.title: Machine Learning Moment Closure for the Boltzmann Transport Equation: Enforcing Hyperbolicity
result.summary: The Boltzmann transport equation describes particle transport across collisional regimes, but resolving its velocity dependence is expensive. Moment methods reduce this cost by evolving finitely many velocity moments, requiring a closure for unresolved higher-order moments. Data-driven closures can represent these moments accurately, yet without structural constraints they may produce complex characteristic speeds and unstable simulations. Learned Boltzmann closures with guaranteed hyperbolicity have so far been formulated in one spatial dimension; in multiple dimensions, hyperbolicity must hold in every direction simultaneously. We develop, to the best of our knowledge, the first data-driven closure for multidimensional Hermite moment systems of the linear Boltzmann equation that is hyperbolic by construction. The network learns a symmetric positive-definite symmetrizer shared by all spatial directions and restricted to a subspace that preserves the known lower-order transport equations; the unresolved rows follow from a symmetric completion. Every directional Jacobian thus has real eigenvalues and a complete set of eigenvectors for every network output and at any truncation order. The closure is trained only on spatial derivatives of unresolved moments from kinetic reference solutions, with no solver in the training loop, and evolved by a partially conservative discontinuous Galerkin method. In two-dimensional experiments in the transition and scattering-dominated regimes, a single learned third-order system with ten moments remains stable in all cases. Averaged over time, it is more accurate than the classical P7 and P15 truncations with 36 and 136 moments in every experiment, and its density error is about two orders of magnitude smaller than that of the P3 truncation with the same moments.

AI.brief_summary: 该文为线性 Boltzmann 方程的二维 Hermite 矩系统提出首个按构造保证双曲性的数据驱动闭合：网络学习各空间方向共享、且限制在保持低阶输运方程子空间内的对称正定对称化子，未解析行由对称补全得到；闭合项仅用动力学参考解的矩空间导数训练，训练中不含求解器，演化采用部分守恒间断 Galerkin 方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对截断后未解析自由度学习闭合、并用结构约束保证状态演化稳定与良定」的思路，可能为 latent 推理中信息坍缩下未建模成分的补偿，以及循环/多步状态更新的稳定性约束提供概念参照；但领域相距较远，可迁移性需人工核查。
